title: BOFT Mirror adapter bank
hypothesis: A shared butterfly orthogonal atom bank plus one scalar task Mirror code recovers factorized BOFT task transforms at lower actual bytes/compute than independent per-task BOFT factors.
physical_object: One shared 16x16 map and one 4-stage x 8-pair butterfly angle bank
mirror_coordinate: One scalar coefficient per task multiplying shared butterfly angle atom
controls: native BOFT independent angle table per task
shared butterfly atom plus Mirror scalar task code

paid_objects: Mirror shared angle bank/task scalar codes

success_gate: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent, payload <=60% independent and >=10% better MSE than native BOFT at byte-near cost or lower bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses gate or BOFT/simple residual matches at equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: teacher deliberately factorized across BOFT task angles
no arbitrary task or language claim

amendments.reason: Development code audit found teacher angle atom/task codes copied into Mirror initialization and teacher angles copied into native BOFT initialization, leaking target coordinates.
amendments.change: All task transform parameters now initialize from neutral zeros/defaults independently of teacher state. Rerun all development methods/LRs/worlds; retain initial rows in a separate invalidated results file.
amendments.scope: Only initialization changed; teacher, methods, seeds, updates, selection metric and fresh gate unchanged.
